top_signals.title: Germany Is Set to Sell 30-Year Bonds at Highest Yield Since 2011
top_signals.summary: Germany’s borrowing costs are poised to hit a 15-year high in a major sale of long-dated bonds as investors demand greater compensation for lending to increasingly-indebted governments still grappling with inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
